outcome: Management procedures for obstetrics and gynaecological patients with COVID-19
Risk of infection for healthcare providers
cohort: The recommendations apply to suspected and confirmed gynaecologic and obstetrics patients, specifically pregnant women, with COVID-19 infection.
finding: The paper reports specific recommendations for the management of suspected and confirmed gynaecologic and obstetrics patients with COVID-19, highlighting the importance of applying appropriate infection control procedures.
mod_finding: The choice of time and mode of delivery can involve conflicting maternal and fetal interests.
